topic: Chuck Norris ends 7 movies — internet's oldest joke wins
new_body_text: Chuck Norris just ended Titanic, Die Hard, Jaws — **the internet's oldest joke wins**
new_caption:
Chuck Norris doesn't act in movies. He attacks them.

Titanic, Die Hard, Jaws, E.T., Batman, Commando, Back to the Future — seven of the biggest films ever made, all ended early by one man in a sleeveless shirt.

No set, no stunt double, no permission slip. Just AI finally letting the internet's oldest joke win.
